skill.name: skill-creator
skill.description: Guides creation, validation, packaging, and installation of AI CLI skills for Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and related agents.
skill.summary: Create AI CLI skills with guided planning, templates, validation, packaging, and installation steps.
skill.author: Eric Andrade

security_audit.summary: Most static command and network alerts are false positives from Markdown examples, placeholder URLs, or benign local validation code. Confirmed issues center on global symlink installation into hidden AI agent directories, missing skill-name path validation, and packaging behavior that may include unintended files.

remediation.issue: Global installation writes symlinks into hidden agent skill directories.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, create target directories safely, refuse to overwrite existing links by default, and show the exact source and destination paths.

remediation.issue: Skill names are documented as hyphen-case but not enforced before filesystem writes.
remediation.suggestion: Validate skill names with a strict lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens pattern before building any path.

remediation.issue: The package script archives every file under the selected skill folder.
remediation.suggestion: Reject symlinks, skip hidden or secret-like files, and print a manifest for user approval before writing the archive.

remediation.issue: The skill declares risk as safe despite security-sensitive installation behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Update risk metadata and user-facing guidance to reflect filesystem writes, external commands, and global installation risks.

semantic_findings.title: Unsanitized Skill Name Can Escape Target Directory
semantic_findings.description: The initializer combines the requested path and skill name before creating directories and files, but it does not validate the skill name. A name containing path separators or an absolute path could write the generated skill outside the intended output directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code and documented shell workflow derive filesystem paths from user-controlled skill names without enforcing the stated hyphen-case rules. The resulting operations create directories and write files.

semantic_findings.title: Misleading Safe Risk Metadata
semantic_findings.description: The skill frontmatter declares risk as safe while the workflow supports global installation through symlinks in hidden agent directories. That mismatch can understate the review needed before installing a community skill.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The safe label is explicit in frontmatter, and later sections instruct global symlink installation into per-user agent configuration paths. The behavior is intentional but security-sensitive.

semantic_findings.title: Package Archive May Include Symlink Targets
semantic_findings.description: The packaging script recursively writes every file found under the skill folder into an archive. It does not reject symlinks or filter unexpected files, which can leak outside file contents if a skill folder contains symlinked files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Path.rglob combined with is_file can include symlinked files, and zipfile.write has no visible filter here. The risk depends on packaging a folder that already contains unsafe links or unrelated files.

content.user_title: Create AI Skills From Guided Templates
content.value_statement: Creating reusable AI skills requires structure, validation, and clear installation choices. This skill guides planning, scaffolding, packaging, and checks for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides users through skill purpose, triggers, target platforms, and installation choices.
Provides a Python initializer that creates SKILL.md plus scripts, references, and assets folders.
Validates SKILL.md frontmatter, naming rules, description limits, and allowed metadata keys.
Packages a validated skill folder into a local .skill archive file.
Documents repository and global installation patterns for Copilot, Claude, and Codex skill directories.
Provides reference guidance for workflow structure and output examples.
limitations: The initializer does not enforce skill name safety before creating directories.
The included validator checks only basic structure and metadata rules.
Global symlink installation can replace existing skill links if used without review.
Several examples use placeholder repository URLs and template paths.

use_cases.title: Package Skill Knowledge
use_cases.description: Turn documentation, workflow patterns, and output examples into a skill that agents can load when needed.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple reusable skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new skill for debugging Python errors. Ask only the essential setup questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Before Creating
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request that needs planning and scope control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a skill for database migrations. Define triggers, folder structure, references, and validation checks before creating files.

prompt_templates.title: Add Resources and Validation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for scripts, references, and quality checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill for API documentation generation. Include reference guidance, example output patterns, and validation steps for SKILL.md.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Marketplace Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced publishing workflow with security and content review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this existing skill for marketplace readiness. Check metadata, trigger clarity, bundled resources, installation steps, and security-sensitive behavior.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for analyzing TypeScript compiler errors.
output: The assistant asks for target users, trigger phrases, platform support, and preferred installation mode.
It then creates a named skill folder with instructions, references, scripts, and validation guidance.

output_examples.input: Package my existing skill for sharing.
output: The assistant validates the skill folder before packaging.
If validation passes, it creates a local distributable archive and reports the output path.

output_examples.input: Improve a draft skill before publishing it.
output: The assistant checks trigger clarity, frontmatter, resource organization, installation steps, and content length.
It suggests focused changes that make the skill easier to load and safer to install.

best_practices: Validate skill names and paths before creating files or installation links.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed material into referenced files.
Ask for explicit confirmation before global installation or overwriting an existing skill.
anti_patterns: Do not install symlinks into global agent directories without user confirmation.
Do not package folders that contain secrets, credentials, or unrelated project files.
Do not rely on placeholder template paths or repository URLs in a finished skill.

faq.question: Which tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It targets Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and related CLI skill workflows.

faq.question: Does it create files automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. The initializer can create SKILL.md and example resource folders under a chosen path.

faq.question: Does it validate security?
faq.answer: No. The validator checks basic structure and metadata, not full security behavior.

faq.question: Can it install skills globally?
faq.answer: The documentation includes global symlink installation steps for agent skill directories.

faq.question: Can it package a skill for distribution?
faq.answer: Yes. The package script creates a local .skill archive after validation succeeds.

faq.question: What should users review before running it?
faq.answer: Review target paths, skill names, bundled files, and any global installation command.
